import datetime
import http.client
import json
import os
import signal
import socket
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from urllib.parse import quote

from tallybook.api.server import make_server, serve
from tallybook.errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError
from tallybook.storage import Store

TODAY = datetime.date(2024, 3, 15)
PROFILE = ("date_column = Date\npayee_column = Payee\namount_column = Amount\ncurrency = USD\n"
           "account = Assets:Cash\ndefault_account = Expenses:Food\n")
CSV = "Date,Payee,Amount\n2024-03-01,Shop,-5.00\n"


class ApiCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.db = os.path.join(self.tmp.name, "book.db")
        Store.open(self.db, create=True).close()
        self.server = make_server(self.db, "127.0.0.1", 0, TODAY)
        self.port = self.server.server_port
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, kwargs={"poll_interval": 0.02},
                                       daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.addCleanup(self.stop)

    def stop(self):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(5)

    def call(self, method, path, body=None, ctype="application/json", headers=None):
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=20)
        hdrs = dict(headers or {})
        if body is not None and ctype is not None:
            hdrs["Content-Type"] = ctype
        if isinstance(body, (dict, list)):
            body = json.dumps(body)
        if isinstance(body, str):
            body = body.encode("utf-8")
        conn.request(method, path, body=body, headers=hdrs)
        resp = conn.getresponse()
        data = resp.read()
        conn.close()
        return resp.status, resp, data

    def jcall(self, method, path, body=None, expect=None, **kw):
        status, resp, data = self.call(method, path, body, **kw)
        if expect is not None:
            self.assertEqual(status, expect, data)
        self.assertEqual(resp.getheader("Content-Type"), "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(resp.getheader("Content-Length"), str(len(data)))
        text = data.decode("utf-8")
        value = json.loads(text)
        self.assertEqual(text, json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        return status, value

    def raw(self, payload):
        sock = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", self.port), timeout=20)
        sock.sendall(payload)
        chunks = []
        while True:
            chunk = sock.recv(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        sock.close()
        head, _, body = b"".join(chunks).partition(b"\r\n\r\n")
        return int(head.split(b" ", 2)[1]), head.decode("latin-1"), body

    def post(self, path, body, expect=None, **kw):
        return self.jcall("POST", path, body, expect, **kw)[1]

    def seed(self):
        for path, cur in (("Assets:Cash", "USD"), ("Equity:Opening", None), ("Income:Salary", None),
                          ("Expenses:Food", None)):
            self.post("/accounts", {"path": path, "currency": cur}, 201)
        self.post("/transactions", {"date": "2024-01-01", "payee": "Opening", "postings": [
            {"account": "Assets:Cash", "amount": "1000.00 USD"}, {"account": "Equity:Opening"}]}, 201)
        self.post("/transactions", {"date": "2024-03-01", "payee": "Acme", "postings": [
            {"account": "Assets:Cash", "amount": {"amount": "2500.00", "currency": "USD"}},
            {"account": "Income:Salary"}]}, 201)
        self.post("/transactions", {"date": "2024-03-02", "payee": "Market", "tags": ["b", "a", "a"],
                                    "postings": [{"account": "Expenses:Food", "amount": "42.50 USD",
                                                  "note": "veg"}, {"account": "Assets:Cash"}]}, 201)


class TestProtocol(ApiCase):
    def test_health(self):
        _, value = self.jcall("GET", "/health", expect=200)
        self.assertEqual(value, {"status": "ok", "version": "1.0.0", "schema_version": 4})

    def test_unknown_paths_are_404(self):
        for path in ("/", "/nothing", "/accounts/", "/transactions//1", "/transactions/abc", "/transactions/-1",
                     "/reports", "/reports/nothing", "/accounts/A/B/C", "/accounts/Assets/open",
                     "/health/", "/budgets/other", "/recurring/other", "//accounts", "/transactions/1/2"):
            with self.subTest(path):
                status, value = self.jcall("GET", path)
                self.assertEqual(status, 404)
                self.assertTrue(value["error"])

    def test_wrong_verb_is_405_with_sorted_allow(self):
        cases = [("DELETE", "/health", "GET"), ("PATCH", "/accounts", "GET, POST"),
                 ("PUT", "/transactions", "GET, POST"), ("POST", "/transactions/1", "DELETE, GET"),
                 ("GET", "/accounts/Assets/close", "POST"), ("GET", "/import", "POST"),
                 ("POST", "/rules", "GET, PUT"), ("POST", "/rates", "DELETE, GET, PUT"),
                 ("PUT", "/budgets", "DELETE, GET, POST"), ("GET", "/recurring/materialize", "POST"),
                 ("POST", "/reports/cashflow", "GET"), ("OPTIONS", "/export", "GET"),
                 ("FOO", "/budgets/status", "GET"), ("DELETE", "/accounts/Assets", "GET")]
        for method, path, allow in cases:
            with self.subTest(method + path):
                status, resp, data = self.call(method, path)
                self.assertEqual(status, 405)
                self.assertEqual(resp.getheader("Allow"), allow)
                self.assertTrue(json.loads(data)["error"])

    def test_head_is_405_without_body(self):
        status, resp, data = self.call("HEAD", "/health")
        self.assertEqual((status, data, resp.getheader("Allow")), (405, b"", "GET"))
        self.assertGreater(int(resp.getheader("Content-Length")), 0)

    def test_connection_close(self):
        _, resp, _ = self.call("GET", "/health")
        self.assertEqual(resp.getheader("Connection"), "close")

    def test_check_order_path_verb_length_type_json(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", "/nothing", b"x", ctype="text/plain")[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("PATCH", "/accounts", b"x", ctype="text/plain")[0], 405)
        big = b"x" * 1048577
        self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", "/accounts", big, ctype="text/plain")[0], 413)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", "/accounts", b"x", ctype="text/plain")[0], 415)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", "/accounts", b"x")[0], 400)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("POST", "/accounts", b"{}")[0], 400)

    def test_body_size_limit(self):
        body = b'{"upto": "2024-01-01"}'
        exact = body + b" " * (1048576 - len(body))
        self.assertEqual(len(exact), 1048576)
        self.assertEqual(self.jcall("POST", "/recurring/materialize", exact)[0], 200)
        status, value = self.jcall("POST", "/recurring/materialize", exact + b" ")
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)
        self.assertTrue(value["error"])
        status, _, _ = self.call("POST", "/recurring/materialize", b" " * 3000000)
        self.assertEqual(status, 413)

    def test_content_types(self):
        for ctype, expect in (("application/json; charset=utf-8", 200), ("APPLICATION/JSON", 200),
                              ("text/plain", 415), ("text/csv", 415), (None, 415), ("application/xml", 415)):
            with self.subTest(ctype):
                status, _, _ = self.call("PUT", "/rules", b'{"rules": ""}', ctype=ctype)
                self.assertEqual(status, expect)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("PUT", "/rules", None, ctype=None)[0], 400)

    def test_bad_bodies_are_400(self):
        for body in (b"{", b"[]", b"1", b'"s"', b"null", b"\xff\xfe", b'{"rules": NaN}', b'{"rules": 1}',
                     b'{"rules": null}', b'{"rules": "", "colour": 1}', b'{"a": ' * 3000):
            with self.subTest(body[:20]):
                status, value = self.jcall("PUT", "/rules", body)
                self.assertEqual(status, 400)
                self.assertTrue(value["error"])
        _, value = self.jcall("PUT", "/rules", b'{"rules": "", "colour": 1}')
        self.assertEqual(value["error"], "unknown field: colour")
        _, value = self.jcall("PUT", "/rules", b"")
        self.assertIn("rules", value["error"])

    def test_bad_content_length_and_request_line(self):
        status, _, body = self.raw(b"POST /accounts HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: abc\r\n\r\n")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(body)["error"])
        status, _, _ = self.raw(b"POST /accounts HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: -5\r\n\r\n")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        status, head, body = self.raw(b"GARBAGE\r\n\r\n")
        self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assertTrue(json.loads(body)["error"])
        self.assertEqual(self.raw(b"GET /health HTTP/9.9\r\n\r\n")[0], 400)

    def call(self, method, path, body=None, ctype="application/json", headers=None):
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", self.port, timeout=20)
        hdrs = dict(headers or {})
        if body is not None and ctype is not None:
            hdrs["Content-Type"] = ctype

        return resp.status, resp, data

        self.assertEqual(resp.getheader("Content-Length"), str(len(data)))
        text = data.decode("utf-8")

        return status, value

            if not chunk:
                break
            chunks.append(chunk)
        sock.close()
        head, _, body = b"".join(chunks).partition(b"\r\n\r\n")
        return int(head.split(b" ", 2)[1]), head.decode("latin-1"), body
